issues.title: Stale Prose in Code Examples
issues.why: Despite AC-21/AC-26, some code examples (e.g., 07-error-handling.md) still use bare integers or 'exit 1' in comments/code which contradicts the typed ExitCode enum requirement.
issues.fix: Replace all literal 'os.Exit(1)' in code blocks with 'os.Exit(int(exit.ExitError))' and add the mandatory AC-21 comment.
